title: Great mountains of the world
examples: Which mountain is the highest in Africa?
Can you compare the height of Everest and Denali?

explain.say: Today we say you will learn about great mountains around the world. We will look at some very tall peaks. Say we start with Mount Everest in the Himalayas.
Next we say you will look at K2. This mountain is very famous and very high too. Say it is located in the Karakoram mountain range.
We say you will learn about Kilimanjaro. This mountain is found in Africa and is very impressive. Say it is a free-standing mountain, not part of a big range.
Now we say you will see Mont Blanc. This mountain is located in Europe and is surrounded by other large mountains. Say it is known for its dramatic scenery.
Finally we say you will learn about Denali. This massive mountain is located in North America. Say it is known for its size and its wild environment.
For a real life example say you are hiking. You need to know the local highest peak. Say this helps you plan your route safely. Say you must know the mountain's general location.

draw.text: Planning a hike: Know your location

faq.q: Which mountain is the absolute tallest on Earth?
faq.a: Mount Everest is recognized as the highest point above sea level on Earth. It is located in the Himalayas.
asks: Where is the tallest peak located?

faq.q: Are all the world's highest mountains in one place?
faq.a: No, the highest mountains are spread across many continents. For example, Kilimanjaro is in Africa.
asks: Do all big mountains form a single range?
Are the highest peaks grouped together?

faq.q: Is the height measured from sea level or from the base?
faq.a: For these famous peaks, the height is usually measured from sea level to the summit. This gives a standard comparison.

faq.q: Do these mountains all belong to the same mountain system?
faq.a: No, they are in different systems. Everest is in the Himalayas, while Denali is in North America.
asks: Are they all part of the same range?
What are the different mountain groups?

faq.q: What is the difference between a mountain range and a single mountain?
faq.a: A range is a line of many mountains together, like the Alps. A single mountain stands alone, like Kilimanjaro.

facts: Mount Everest is located in the Himalayas.
Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.
Denali is a major mountain in North America.
Mont Blanc is a prominent peak in the Alps of Europe.

quiz.say: If you are looking for the highest mountain in Africa, which one should you study?
quiz.why: Kilimanjaro is the mountain specifically recognized as the highest peak on the African continent.

wrong.1: Everest is the highest overall, but it is not in Africa.
wrong.2: Denali is in North America, not Africa.
wrong.3: Mont Blanc is located in Europe.

quiz.say: Which mountain is known for being in the Karakoram range?
quiz.why: K2 is correctly identified as a major peak within the Karakoram mountain system.

wrong.0: Denali is in North America, not Asia.
wrong.1: Mont Blanc is part of the European Alps.
wrong.3: Everest is in the Himalayas, which is a different range.

quiz.say: If you compare the highest points, which continent does Denali represent?
quiz.why: Denali is a famous and large mountain located in the continent of North America.

wrong.0: Europe's major peak shown is Mont Blanc.
wrong.2: Asia contains Everest, which is much higher.
